state: Baseline and planned dispositions only; implementation and final local boundary evidence are pending.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Signed local readback exists. Both listening sessions observing an exchange and resuming from a cursor remains unproved.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Two original running readers exchange and resume signed events offline and on the shared local Companion.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Explicit unavailable remote status/audit returned successful local reads; watch failed.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Explicit missing remote fails consistently; local reads identify local source; conflicts and uncertain retries preserve authority and do not duplicate the event.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Live two-session ownership handoff remains unproved.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Second session accepts exactly once and conflicting, unauthorized or replayed claims preserve ownership.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Older embedded reader rejected operator_granted while opening the signed seed.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Align four crate pins and lockfile; replay independently signed supported co-operator and legacy history, and fail closed for a signed unknown future event.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Signed command reached A; B did not discover A or receive the event. Healthy HTTP and an acknowledged A command did not prove B applied anything.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Observe addressed transport and B’s independent audit, live stream and checkout for A’s exact signed event, then the reply in A’s original reader.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Disconnected, denied and ambiguous submissions require independent evidence after the receiver works.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Exercise real offline/denied endpoints, restore service, reconcile identity and project rights, verify the duplicate retry leaves history unchanged.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Import can durably persist before checkout refresh; a retry that inserts zero updates can leave stale projection. Bounded backlog delivery also remains unverified.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Use the contract backlog size/frame budget; interrupt after durable import and verify a replay repairs the checkout without duplicating journal or stream entries.

scenarioDisposition.finding: Nine installed doctor failures and one discovery warning.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Record unfiltered doctor from separately provisioned skills-only and full consumer installs, resolve failures and discovery warning, justify applicability and skips, and keep signed standalone and service regressions.

scenarioDisposition.finding: 130 Full items failed strict accounting. Companion passed its single change after mirroring.
scenarioDisposition.closureEvidence: Both complete workspaces must pass strict validation. Reconcile every original (type,id) to a valid item or an evidenced legitimate successor and retain prior passes.

candidate.rule: Record resolved revisions, binary hashes and owning worktrees for the final local run. Use fresh disposable per-authority roots, independent keys, explicit sockets, and a shared local authority only for its designated cases; preserve operator journals and services.

remediationGroups.missing-delta: Recover the change’s approved requirement and its scenarios from the authored record and implement the proper capability delta. Inspect proposal, execution record, signed phase approvals and canonical behavior before mapping; a proposal alone is a lead, not proof of approved wording. If migration genuinely superseded an item, record its exact historical ID, successor, scope, authority, and strict result.
remediationGroups.purpose: Recover the capability purpose from the accepted requirements and archive/proposal provenance. Replace the main spec placeholder with its actual purpose.
remediationGroups.long-requirement: Preserve the normative behavior and accepted scenarios. Put examples and exceptional cases in scenarios, or split separately enforceable requirements. Validate the precise item and whole workspace.
remediationGroups.retain-pass: Preserve prior coverage and strict validation for the exact item or an explicitly evidenced canonical successor.

issues.message: Purpose section is still a placeholder rather than a Purpose anyone wrote (the sentence `openspec archive` writes for a new capability, or a `TBD`/`TODO` marker left in its place). Replace it with what this capability is for, editing the main spec directly: a `## Purpose` in a delta is read only when the capability is created, so it cannot replace this one.
Requirement text is very long (>500 characters). Move examples and edge cases into scenarios, or split it into separate requirements that each state one behavior.
